description: This file defines the StateContainer class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing session-based state data during the installation process. It includes constants for configuration keys, methods to store and retrieve database info, versioning, instance data, admin user data, registration consent, and migration status. The class interacts with session management and service containers to persist data across installation steps.

classes.name: StateContainer
classes.description: A singleton class managing session-based persistent state data during the installation process of OrangeHRM, including database configuration, versioning, instance details, admin user info, registration consent, migration state, and current installation screen.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the StateContainer.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a session attribute with the given name and value.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute by name, with an optional default.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a session attribute exists.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a session attribute.

methods.name: getAllAttributes
methods.description: Returns all session attributes as an array.

methods.name: storeDbInfo
methods.description: Stores database connection info and related credentials in session.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Retrieves stored database connection info.

methods.name: clearDbInfo
methods.description: Clears all stored database connection info from session.

methods.name: isSetDbInfo
methods.description: Checks if database info has been set.

methods.name: setDbType
methods.description: Stores the database type in session.

methods.name: getDbType
methods.description: Retrieves the stored database type.

methods.name: setCurrentScreen
methods.description: Sets the current installer screen and whether it is an upgrader.

methods.name: getCurrentScreen
methods.description: Gets the current installer screen.

methods.name: isUpgrader
methods.description: Determines if the current process is an upgrader.

methods.name: setCurrentVersion
methods.description: Sets the current version of the application.

methods.name: getCurrentVersion
methods.description: Gets the current version of the application.

methods.name: storeInstanceData
methods.description: Stores organization, location, language, and timezone data.

methods.name: getInstanceData
methods.description: Retrieves stored instance data.

methods.name: storeAdminUserData
methods.description: Stores admin user details in session.

methods.name: getAdminUserData
methods.description: Retrieves admin user data.

methods.name: storeRegConsent
methods.description: Stores registration consent status.

methods.name: getRegConsent
methods.description: Retrieves registration consent status.

methods.name: storeInstanceIdentifierData
methods.description: Stores an identifier for the installation instance.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifierData
methods.description: Retrieves the instance identifier data.

methods.name: storeInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Stores initial registration data and installer state.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Retrieves initial registration data and installer state.

methods.name: setMigrationCompleted
methods.description: Sets the migration completed flag.

methods.name: isMigrationCompleted
methods.description: Checks if migration has been completed.

methods.name: clearMigrationCompleted
methods.description: Clears the migration completion flag.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Resets session data while preserving current screen and upgrader state.
